title: Mode-I C6 Package 171-R11 Safeguarded Limited-Memory Anderson Acceleration Driver Implementation and Technical Qualification

operation.registration: Package 171-R11 C6 Safeguarded Limited-Memory Anderson Acceleration Offline Qualification; strictly 0 PBS submissions authorized

job_references.scientific_scope: Offline driver implementation and controlled unit regression testing for Candidate R11 safeguarded limited-memory Anderson acceleration applied to the coupled staggered damage fixed-point sequence after active-set stabilization. Memory depth m = 2 or 3 with regularized least-squares coefficients. Intrinsic raw damage fixed-point residual r_k = d_PDAS - d_current used for mixing. Preservation of physical damage bounds 0 <= d <= 1, historical lower bound d >= d0, frozen UEL, C6 mesh, crack-seam mapping, donor state, and physical acceptance thresholds. Explicit projection and rejection/rollback safeguards. Consistent recomputation of displacement and driving history without hybrid state mixing. Strictly 0 PBS submissions authorized under F1617.

decision_branches: SAFEGUARDED_ANDERSON_ACCELERATION: apply limited-memory Anderson mixing (m=2 or 3) to the damage fixed-point sequence after active set stabilizes
INTRINSIC_RESIDUAL_FORMULATION: compute residual as raw fixed point difference r = d_PDAS - d_current
PROJECTION_AND_SAFEGUARDED_ROLLBACK: enforce physical bounds [d0, 1.0] and fallback to damped Picard step if residual increases
CONSISTENT_COUPLED_EVALUATION: recompute displacement and driving history consistently from accelerated damage
OFFLINE_UNIT_REGRESSION: test on controlled mock problems and verify convergence, stability, and rollback behavior before cluster staging
